effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When any of your [Composite] or [Twilight] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements would be played, by suspending this Tamer, 1 card under your Tamers and 1 card in your trash can also be placed for their DigiXros.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
